items.name: frost-field
items.title: Frost Field
items.description: Calm light glass for wellness products. Frosted white panels and floating chrome over a fixed pastel aurora field (lavender, sky, mint, peach); Manrope display over Inter body; a high-fill glass recipe (0.55 regular, 0.72 under body text, 0.35 chrome only) with solid reduced-transparency and near-opaque no-backdrop fallbacks; pill controls, 14px/20px radii, airy one-idea-per-card density.
